program.name: Balance Flow
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: One-leg yoga poses strung into flows: tree, warrior three, half moon and dancer.
program.about: One-leg poses strung into flows, for steadier ankles, hips and focus. Tree, warrior three, half moon and dancer come back often, between standing poses that rest the standing leg. One day adds floor work for the hips and the other adds core. Level II holds each pose longer and Level III brings harder versions. Near a wall is fine while you find your balance.
